results.title: When America Took the Field
results.overview: How baseball helped restore normalcy and unite the country after the September 11 attacks.

results.title: When Will You Get Divorced?
results.overview: A bride and her new sister-in-law get mixed up in the world of international jewel theft and espionage after the groom vanishes from the wedding.

results.title: Gangster’s Daughter 5
results.overview: After a crushing loss, Kadisha cannot grieve before a new threat emerges, turning friends into foes in a world where nothing is as it seems.

results.title: Short Cuts: “The Diary of a Chambermaid” by Luis Buñuel
results.original_title: Short cuts : “Le journal d’une femme de chambre” de Luis Buñuel
results.overview: Director Yujia Wang summarises Luis Buñuel's "The Diary of a Chambermaid" in a one-minute animated film.

results.title: Survivor 50: Epic Party
results.overview: 24 returning players are abandoned on the islands of Fiji for a monumental 50th season, with the chance to win $1 million. The theme of the season, "In the Hands of the Fans," quickly materializes as decisions from the fan vote swiftly and forcefully impact the game. Castaways reflect on how much they have changed since the last time they played the game. Then, an unforeseen injury during the first immunity challenge causes tribemates to rethink their attack strategy in order to support their team member.

results.title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
results.original_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
results.overview: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

results.title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
results.original_title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
results.overview: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.

results.title: Heavy
results.overview: A man cleans up a murder.

results.title: When Heaven Inched Towards Earth
results.overview: In a Catholic high school in Bulacan, a farm boy’s bond with a sacristan forces him to grapple with faith, shame, and the space between heaven and earth.

results.title: Fruit Gathering
results.overview: In industrial Yangon, young factory worker San Kyi dreams of returning to her native village. Her relationship with co-worker Theint Theint Oo evolves from closeness to growing distance, revealing tensions between their expectations and life prospects. Amid exhausting labour, social repression, and economic uncertainty, both women seek escape and intimacy.

results.title: Momacu
results.overview: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

results.title: The Mask One: Faceless
results.original_title: បាត់ខ្លួន 5 នាក់
results.overview: A troubled medium joins a crew of ghost-hunting con artists, but when the isolated jungle they investigate begins claiming victims through face-erasing murders, she must reveal her genuine gift or become the ancient entity’s next target.

results.title: Budapest Festival Orchestra - Kissinger Sommer Opening Concert
results.original_title: Budapest Festival Orchestra Kissinger Sommer Opening Concert
results.overview: It was during one of the rare happy periods of his life that Schumann composed his third symphony and a palpable joy can be heard in this masterpiece. In contrast Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 24 is, like many of the composer's minor-key pieces, imbued with a profound melancholy. Accomplished pianist Elisabeth Leonskaja is soloist with the Budapest Festival Orchestra conducted by its founder Iván Fischer.  Programme:  Sergei Prokofiev Overture on Hebrew Themes  Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart Piano Concerto No. 24 in C minor KV 491  Robert Schumann Symphony No. 3 in E flat major "Rhenish"

results.title: Plötzlich Schwiegervater
results.overview: Paul Hagedorn’s beloved daughter, Annette, wants to get married. But from the very first moment, Hagedorn and his future son-in-law, Joe, can’t stand each other. Their first meeting ends in a physical altercation that leads to legal consequences. What begins as a personal conflict quickly escalates into a bitter power struggle between the two men, leaving Annette caught in the middle…

results.title: Cheesecake
results.overview: A husband sets out to buy cheesecake for his pregnant wife, only to be swallowed by city chaos as she goes into labor alone.

results.title: Disneyland Handcrafted
results.overview: Oscar and Emmy nominated filmmaker Leslie Iwerks returns with an all-new Disney documentary giving viewers an up-close look at the dedication, effort, and passion that was required to realize a dream that would go on to inspire millions around the world.

results.title: Beyond Memories
results.overview: Giuseppe, an old man suffering from Alzheimer's is going to a funeral with his wife. On his way, he gets lost in his forgotten memories...

results.title: Tana
results.overview: Told her music lacks "soul", Tana returns from Shanghai to Inner Mongolian Grasslands when her father falls ill. Guided by a fiddle fairy, she begins a journey through memory, music and the home she once longed to leave.
